# Terms that must never appear in the repo. Checked in CI by scripts/check-denylist.ps1.
# Fossil is a generic product: no client names, no personal absolute paths.
# Client and company names go hashed, one word per line, so this file never publishes them:
#   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/check-denylist.ps1 -Hash <word>
# and paste the sha256:... line it prints. Plain lines are fixed strings (paths).
# Hashed words also cover names of other products: Fossil does not name or compare itself with them.
